drafts.headline: Cost of sales forecasts run about 36% too low for ABUK.
drafts.plain: The method misses this driver in the same direction almost every time, not at random. That is a fixable defect rather than noise — find what is wired wrong before adding any correction factor.
drafts.evidence: Bias -0.310 log (about 36% too low), average miss 0.338, wrong in the same direction in 80% of cases, and the sign holds across every bootstrap block tested (n=20).
drafts.why_scope: ABUK's gas cost is contractually formula-linked to its own output price with a USD 8.50/mmBtu floor. That is this issuer's contract, not a property of fertiliser producers or of Egyptian industrials, and applying it elsewhere would be the superstition the scope rule exists to prevent.
drafts.overturned_by: A later run of the same name where the sign no longer holds across bootstrap blocks.
drafts.declined: Ruled STOCK and then WITHDRAWN, because a STOCK lesson names a study to bind on and ABUK has no study — no fair value was struck in this run. check_lessons_register refused it in those words and was right to: a stock lesson about a company with no study is a lesson nobody can apply, and lessons.py would return it to a reader who has nothing to apply it to. The findings are not lost — the gas-formula cost linkage and the 9.9% macro share on non-operating income are both in TRAINING_RECORD_09-09-2026.md and MACRO_DECOMPOSITION_09-09-2026.md, where the next pass on this name will read them. They are re-proposed when ABUK is built.

drafts.headline: The method under-forecasts nominal revenue wherever a currency steps.
drafts.plain: Every origin holds the exchange rate flat because that is all that is knowable then. In a stepping currency that is a systematic downward lean on every nominal line, and it compounds with the horizon. Read any nominal forecast in such a market as a floor rather than a central until the currency leg is carried explicitly.
drafts.evidence: Bias -0.469 log (about 60% too low), average miss 0.497, wrong in the same direction in 85% of cases, and the sign holds across every bootstrap block tested (n=20).
drafts.why_scope: THE MECHANISM IS IN THE METHOD, NOT IN EGYPT, which is why this is ALL and not a class of company. Every origin in every run holds the exchange rate at its origin-dated value because that is the only thing knowable at the origin — the method does that on every name in every market. Egyptian data does not create the defect, it REVEALS it, because a currency that steps three times in six years makes a flat-FX assumption visible where a drifting one hides it. Scoping this CLASS would put the defect in the companies instead of in us. Its MAGNITUDE is regime-dependent and is predicted to be near zero under a peg, which is the falsifier and is exactly what the UAE leg tests.
drafts.overturned_by: A market whose currency did not step showing the same lean — the UAE leg is the test, and the mechanism predicts a macro share near zero there. A peg that shows -0.30 log of revenue bias refutes this.

drafts.headline: The volume proxy forecast loses to assuming no change.
drafts.plain: At 5 of 5 horizons, simply carrying last year's number forward beat the model. A method that cannot beat 'no change' has not earned the precision it displays, and should be published as a range or not at all.
drafts.evidence: Negative skill against the freeze benchmark at horizons 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, worst -0.213.
drafts.why_scope: Losing to a naive benchmark usually points at the method, which would make it ALL — but confirm it is not this company's series being unusually persistent.
drafts.overturned_by: A later run where the model beats the freeze benchmark at a majority of horizons.
drafts.declined: Not a finding. Both are readings of ONE wiring defect — the volume proxy is revenue divided by the urea price, so its 'bias' is the commodity leg's mirror and the two cancel to -0.0013 log across 20 cells. Filed once, as DRAFT-ABUK-18, where it belongs.

drafts.headline: The non-operating income error is the company, not the currency.
drafts.plain: Re-running every forecast with perfect foresight of inflation barely improves it. So devaluation is not the explanation, and looking for a macro fix would waste the effort.
drafts.evidence: Average miss 0.845 as known, 0.761 with perfect foresight of inflation — the macro share is only 9.9%.
drafts.why_scope: A measured fact about this issuer: with perfect foresight of inflation the non-operating income error barely moves — a macro share of 9.9% — so the error is the company's own. True of ABUK, established on ABUK, and carried no further.
drafts.overturned_by: A market or period where the same decomposition puts most of the error on the macro path.
drafts.declined: Ruled STOCK and then WITHDRAWN, because a STOCK lesson names a study to bind on and ABUK has no study — no fair value was struck in this run. check_lessons_register refused it in those words and was right to: a stock lesson about a company with no study is a lesson nobody can apply, and lessons.py would return it to a reader who has nothing to apply it to. The findings are not lost — the gas-formula cost linkage and the 9.9% macro share on non-operating income are both in TRAINING_RECORD_09-09-2026.md and MACRO_DECOMPOSITION_09-09-2026.md, where the next pass on this name will read them. They are re-proposed when ABUK is built.

drafts.headline: Test whether the macro path explains an error before assuming it does.
drafts.plain: Substitute the actual macro path and re-measure. If the error falls, it is macro; if it does not move, it is the company; if it RISES, the macro path is wired into that line the wrong way round and no correction factor will fix it.
drafts.evidence: Average miss 0.646 as known, 0.585 with perfect foresight of inflation — the macro share is only 9.4%.
drafts.why_scope: The specific reading — that ABUK's overheads error is the company rather than the currency — is this issuer's. The GENERAL form is not, and it is the part worth carrying: the same test on cost of sales returned a NEGATIVE macro share in both eras, meaning perfect foresight of the macro path made the forecast WORSE. An error in a high-inflation market looks macro and need not be.
drafts.overturned_by: A line where substituting the actual macro path never changes the error in either direction, making the test uninformative rather than diagnostic.

drafts.headline: The cost of sales bias changes direction between regimes.
drafts.plain: It runs one way in one period and the other way in the next. Averaging them produces a correction that is wrong in both. Record it, do not correct for it.
drafts.evidence: By era: E1 pre-spike FY2020-FY2021 +0.088; E2 spike and after FY2022-FY2025 -0.380.
drafts.why_scope: A sign that flips with the regime is usually about the market or the period, not the company — but say which.
drafts.overturned_by: A longer record in which one sign dominates across all regimes.
drafts.declined: Rests on a three-cell era. Every era-flip draft contrasts E1 (FY2020-2021, n=3) with E2 (n=17), and three observations do not establish that a bias was absent before the break. criterion3.py already reports the same limitation about itself — 'E1 pre-float cells 0 — TOO THIN TO BE A SIDE' — and filing a finding on three cells here would be the error that clause exists to refuse.

drafts.headline: A driver defined as another driver's denominator is not independent evidence about either.
drafts.plain: Check the definitions before scoring two drivers as two findings. If one is computed from the other, their errors will mirror and cancel, and a correction factor applied to either hides the wiring instead of fixing it.
drafts.evidence: ABUK's volume proxy is defined as revenue divided by the urea price and the exchange rate. Across 20 cells the volume leg and the commodity-price leg correlate at -0.578 with a slope of -1.28 against an exact-cancellation -1.00, and the two legs SUM to -0.0013 log — they cancel to within a tenth of a percent. Two of this run's drafts were two readings of that one defect.
drafts.why_scope: Nothing here is about fertiliser, Egypt or this issuer. It is about how a driver set is specified, and any run that derives one driver from another can produce the same false pair.
drafts.overturned_by: A run where two drivers are definitionally linked and their error legs do NOT cancel — which would mean the linkage is not load-bearing and the two can be scored apart after all.
